audience: real-estate photographers and media companies using Aryeo

useCases.title: Review unpaid media orders
useCases.text: Find unpaid orders and read their details, customer and fulfillment status.

useCases.title: Plan upcoming shoots
useCases.text: Review appointments, team calendars and available times before choosing a new appointment time.

useCases.title: Reschedule a shoot
useCases.text: Move an appointment after checking availability. Choose explicitly whether Aryeo should notify the customer.

useCases.title: Update an internal order note
useCases.text: Read the existing notes, then replace the full internal note with the intended text.

useCases.title: Track delivery tasks
useCases.text: Review tasks and create a task for the next editing or delivery step.
